The breeding hood is chocolate-brown rather than truly black. This is a sociable gull: watch a flock together and compare how the birds feed, call and settle.

Source: [RSPB Black-headed Gull guide](https://www.rspb.org.uk/birds-and-wildlife/black-headed-gull).
